case_number: 2025 INSC 107; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 (@ S.L.P.(C) Nos. 20702-03 of 2021)

parties.respondent: The Manager, Oriental Insurance Company Limited and Others

summary: Motor accident compensation; admitted 70% disability; High Court's reduction to Rs.2,10,000/- for loss of income unsustainable; Rs.3,000/- per percentage arbitrary; no disability certificate but serious head injuries established; employability impaired; Tribunal's multiplier approach modified but not entirely rejected; compensation for loss of earning capacity redetermined to Rs.7,50,000/-; appeals partly allowed; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: National Insurance Company Limited v. Pranay Sethi
New India Assurance Company Limited v. Urmila Shukla
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; High Court judgment set aside; compensation for loss of earning capacity awarded at Rs.7,50,000/-; total compensation redetermined.
